items.exampleEn: She has a red ribbon in her hair.
items.exampleZh: 她頭髮上綁著一條紅色緞帶。

items.exampleEn: My mother wears an apron when she cooks.
items.exampleZh: 我媽媽煮飯時會穿圍裙。

items.exampleEn: I get a haircut every month.
I wear glasses when I read.
I wear a T-shirt in summer.

items.audioEn: Please wear an apron in the kitchen. Your T-shirt is white.
items.audioZh: 在廚房請穿圍裙，你的 T 恤是白色的。
items.questionZh: 說話者要你在廚房穿什麼？

items.sentenceEn: The girl has a pink ribbon in her hair.
items.sentenceZh: 那個女孩頭髮上綁著一條粉紅色緞帶。

items.stemEn: I can't see well. Where are my ____?
items.stemZh: 我看不清楚，我的眼鏡在哪裡？

items.stemEn: Your hair is too long. Go and get a ____.
items.stemZh: 你的頭髮太長了，去剪個頭髮吧。

items.passageEn: Kevin works at a small cafe. Every morning, he puts on a white T-shirt, black pants, and a long apron. He wears glasses because he can't see well. Today he has a new haircut, and everyone says he looks great.
items.passageZh: Kevin 在一家小咖啡店工作。每天早上，他穿上白色 T 恤、黑色褲子和一件長圍裙。他戴眼鏡，因為他看不清楚。今天他剪了新髮型，大家都說他看起來很棒。

questions.questionZh: Kevin 上班穿什麼顏色的褲子？

items.promptZh: 我夏天都穿 T 恤。
referenceEn: I always wear a T-shirt in summer.
rubricZh: T-shirt（寫成 t-shirt 也接受，大小寫不扣分），泛指時可用複數 T-shirts

items.instructionZh: 用 glasses 造一個句子，說說你或你身邊的人戴眼鏡的情況。
referenceEn: My father wears glasses when he reads.
rubricZh: glasses 是複數，當主詞時動詞用 are（例如 My glasses are new）
